purpose: Detect whether the observed conditional sufficient statistic lies on the boundary of its convex support, rather than treating a small finite-point gradient and full finite-point Hessian rank as proof that a finite CMLE maximizer exists.

known_trigger_not_prospective_result.design: Binary two-Rater complete overlap; every Person has response pattern R1=1, R2=0.
known_trigger_not_prospective_result.observed_problem: The conditional likelihood has a maximizing direction at infinity, but the current finite stopping/rank gates returned approximately +/-10 to +/-12 logit effects as inference-ready over exploratory Person counts 2 through 300.
known_trigger_not_prospective_result.interpretation: This trigger motivated the plan and cannot be counted as a prospective discovery or used alone to validate the new diagnostic.

mathematical_contract.model_family: Minimal regular conditional exponential family after exact free-coordinate construction and prefit full-rank audit.
mathematical_contract.existence_statement: A finite CMLE exists only when the observed aggregate conditional sufficient statistic is in the relative interior of the Minkowski sum of the score-stratum support polytopes.
mathematical_contract.stratum: One unique response-unit design pattern and observed raw score, with its Person frequency and score-specific observed sufficient-statistic sum.
mathematical_contract.support: All attainable response vectors on the declared category support having the stratum raw score, mapped through the exact row/category free-coordinate design.
mathematical_contract.boundary_direction: A nonzero free-coordinate direction d for which d'*(n_s*T - t_obs_s) <= 0 for every support point T in every stratum s; this makes the observed statistic a support-plane maximizer.
mathematical_contract.authoritative_scale: The exact free-coordinate design, including hard-anchor affine offsets only where they affect score support/observed likelihood; fixed offsets do not become free separation directions.
mathematical_contract.rank_prerequisite: If exact conditional information is rank deficient before fitting, report structural nonidentification first and do not relabel it as separation.

implementation_contract.score_specific_observed_statistics: Retain or reconstruct observed free-coordinate sufficient-statistic sums separately for every pattern-score stratum; do not use only the current across-score aggregate.
implementation_contract.support_enumeration: Exact bounded dynamic enumeration for registered small/medium RSM/PCM patterns, with deduplication of identical sufficient-statistic points and explicit work/constraint/memory caps.
implementation_contract.linear_program: Search the homogeneous boundary cone by maximizing and minimizing every free-coordinate component under all support-plane inequalities and a bounded normalization box. Use scipy HiGHS and retain raw solver status, residuals, direction, active constraints, and tolerances.

requirements: direct exact conditional log likelihood is nondecreasing along a reported maximizing direction within declared binary64 tolerance
directional score tends toward zero without a finite interior sign reversal for separated fixtures
the reported direction satisfies retained support inequalities and normalization
finite fixtures do not receive a maximizing-boundary direction across the primary tolerance contract

implementation_contract.fail_closed: Enumeration cap, LP failure, tolerance instability, or unsupported pattern yields ExistenceStatus=unavailable/review, never finite_mle_confirmed.
forbidden_shortcuts: parameter clipping, regularization, or finite correction labelled CMLE
silently dropping support points, extreme Persons, facets, or anchors to obtain a decision

cases: balanced finite interior with both discordant response directions observed
near-boundary finite samples with exactly one discordant response in the minority direction
connected chain with both edges finite
one separated edge and one finite edge
zero/one/two correct hard anchors with component coverage recorded
three- and four-category finite complete designs
category-direction separation under fixed Person totals
RSM shared steps and rectangular PCM criterion-specific steps
unused declared category and conditional-extreme Person controls
correct and differentially contaminated hard-Rater anchors

registered_fixture_families.cases: All 350 prefit audits and 287 eligible fit inputs from the retained connectivity bytes, preserving topology, randomized anchor content, final rank, non-finite trial, and readiness identities.

frozen_outputs: complete fixture and retained-replay ledger including unavailable/failure rows
stratum frequencies, support-point counts, enumeration work/memory, and deduplication counts
LP statuses and residuals over the tolerance grid
normalized boundary direction and active support constraints where present
directional likelihood and directional-score trace over frozen radii
current optimizer return/convergence/readiness and maximum estimate/SE for contrast only
same-byte retained connectivity transition table from current readiness to existence-qualified readiness
first-read projection separating identification, finite-MLE existence, optimization, final rank, and Person-scoring availability

success_gates.rank_deficient_controls: All are classified structural_nonidentification before separation.
success_gates.complete_separation_controls: All prospective variants and both directions receive a stable boundary direction and cannot be existence-qualified.
success_gates.finite_interior_controls: All prospectively generated interior fixtures receive no boundary direction across the primary tolerance contract and agree with direct finite optimization.
success_gates.near_boundary_controls: Minority-direction finite fixtures remain distinct from complete separation; tolerance instability is surfaced rather than coerced.
success_gates.directional_verification: Every reported direction passes support inequalities and the registered likelihood/score trace checks.
success_gates.retained_replay_accounting: All 350 cases are ledgered; all 287 prefit-eligible inputs receive a status or a typed unavailable reason.
success_gates.existing_numerics: The finite-domain remediation returnability, structural estimates, likelihoods, WLE, MnSq, and raw/rounded decisions remain unchanged; the new gate can only withhold additional inference.

interpretation_limits.initial_algorithm: Exact support enumeration is a research implementation with explicit caps, not yet a scalable public algorithm.
interpretation_limits.lp_tolerance: Binary64/solver sensitivity must be retained; no single residual cutoff is universal.
interpretation_limits.finite_existence: Passing the registered diagnostic addresses an interior-support condition for the implemented model, not model fit, local independence, anchor validity, or score-use validity.
interpretation_limits.regularized_alternatives: Firth, Bayesian priors, penalties, or finite corrections require separately named estimators and cannot be reported as exact unpenalized CMLE.
interpretation_limits.cross_engine: mfrmr, immer, TAM, and sirt may use different boundary handling, Person treatment, constraints, or regularization; return codes are not forced into parity.
